stories.label: Iran war Day 23: Hypersonic missiles deployed, mass informant arrests, refugee crisis
stories.summary: Day 23: Iran deploys hypersonic missiles (joining exclusive tech club), regime arrests dozens of alleged Israeli informants, UN reports Iranians fleeing to neighbouring countries. Trump rejected deal terms. War generating refugee crisis, intelligence war, and new weapons deployment simultaneously.

stories.label: Hormuz economic fallout: Egypt crisis, Malaysia black markets, pipeline disputes
stories.summary: Hormuz crisis now generating second-order effects: Egypt's economy under dual pressure (inflation + Suez revenue collapse), black-market fuel networks emerging in Southeast Asia (Malaysia bust), Ukraine-EU pipeline revenue dispute. Energy crisis reshaping alliances and creating criminal economies.

stories.label: Israeli troops kill family in West Bank, soldiers say 'we killed dogs'
stories.summary: Escalating pattern: settlers shooting Palestinians in Qusra, now IDF troops killing entire family including children and dehumanising victims ('we killed dogs'). Occupation violence accelerating under Iran war cover.

stories.label: Sudan: RSF drone campaign + 169 killed in South Sudan by RSF-armed militias
stories.summary: Sudan war metastasising: SAF retook Bara but RSF launching drone campaign in Kordofan/Blue Nile. RSF-armed militias crossed into South Sudan, killing at least 169. Hemedti facing internal tensions with Rizeigat leadership.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan tensions
stories.summary: Pakistan struck deep inside Afghanistan (Kandahar). India criticized Pakistan's operations.

stories.label: Japan deploys Type-12 long-range missiles near East China Sea
stories.summary: Japan deployed domestically produced long-range missiles near East China Sea.

stories.label: Chinese-financed cartel squeezes Thai coconut farmers
stories.summary: Thai coconut farmers getting 2 baht (6 US cents) per coconut — record low.

stories.label: Western alliance fractures: Canada-Nordics middle power bloc, Zelensky vs EU
stories.summary: Canada and Nordic countries forming 'middle power' cooperation bloc — NATO allies hedging against US unilateralism. Combined with Zelensky accusing EU of 'blackmail' over pipelines, the Western alliance system is fragmenting.

stories.label: North Africa: Algeria and Morocco repositioning amid Iran war
stories.summary: Algeria (Russian/Iranian weapons buyer) and Morocco (Abraham Accords signatory) both recalibrating positions as Iran war forces strategic choices.

stories.label: Uganda: Opposition leader forced into exile after 2 months hiding
stories.summary: Major Ugandan opposition figure forced abroad after two months in hiding. Museveni has ruled 40 years.

stories.label: Egypt: Inflation surge + foreign currency drain + Suez revenue collapse
stories.summary: Egypt's economy under triple pressure: rising inflation, shrinking foreign currency reserves, and Suez Canal revenue collapsing due to Iran war shipping disruptions.

stories.label: US backs Argentina in YPF nationalisation case against own investors
stories.summary: US government backs Argentina against US-based investors in YPF nationalisation case — likely motivated by need for Argentine lithium and Vaca Muerta energy during Hormuz crisis.

stories.label: India-EU: Jaishankar in Brussels as India plays all sides
stories.summary: India's FM Jaishankar visiting Brussels. India buying Iranian oil while deepening EU ties — the quintessential swing power.

stories.label: Indonesia: Danantara sovereign wealth fund builds semiconductor ecosystem
stories.summary: Indonesia's Danantara partnering with education ministry to build domestic semiconductor capabilities. Global South chip sovereignty play during US-China tech war.

stories.label: GitAgent: open standard for portable AI agents
stories.summary: Open standard defining AI agents as git repo files.

stories.label: Cuba: Protesters attack Communist party office amid blackout
stories.summary: Anti-government protesters attacked Communist party office. Blackouts worsened by US oil blockade.

stories.label: Meta cuts 20%+ workforce for AI
stories.summary: Meta planning 20%+ layoffs to fund AI infrastructure.

stories.label: Tesla Terafab AI chip factory
stories.summary: Musk announces Tesla Terafab chip fabrication facility.

stories.label: Trump FCC threatens news outlets
stories.summary: FCC threatens license revocation for outlets sharing distortions about US war.

stories.label: US science infrastructure under attack
stories.summary: NIH whistleblower warns research capacity being gutted.

stories.label: AI war fakes flooding X
stories.summary: AI disinformation about Iran war flooding X.

stories.label: Kenyan AI data labelers form union
stories.summary: Data Labelers Association formed in Kenya.

stories.label: Vietnam general election: 93% Communist Party
stories.summary: Vietnam holds general election with 93% ruling party candidates.

stories.label: Congo-Brazzaville: Sassou Nguesso 40-year rule
stories.summary: Denis Sassou Nguesso (82) running for re-election after 40 years.

stories.summary: Gas cuts prevent Karachi families from cooking during Ramadan.

stories.summary: Greenland recorded warmest winter ever.
